title: Night Prayer for Healing | Rest Your Body and Heart in God's Care
description:
Hurting in body or heart? Bring every pain to the God who heals, then fall asleep to healing Scripture read slowly over you: Psalm 103, Psalm 23, Psalm 46, Isaiah 43 and more.

Chapters
0:00 Opening prayer
0:37 Heal me, O Lord (Jeremiah 17:14)
1:29 He binds up wounds (Psalm 147:3)
2:16 Psalm 41:3
3:39 Healing for the heart
4:08 By his stripes (Isaiah 53:5)
5:27 Be still (Psalm 46:10)
5:46 Psalm 6:2
6:14 2 Corinthians 4:16
7:59 Psalm 30:2
8:05 Forget not his benefits (Psalm 103:2-3)
9:31 No more pain (Revelation 21:4)
10:20 Romans 8:28
11:50 Declaration for tonight
12:10 Psalm 3:5
12:38 One thing to do tonight
12:53 Healing Scripture for sleep
14:34 Who healeth all thy diseases (Psalm 103)
16:03 He restoreth my soul (Psalm 23)
17:07 Be still and know (Psalm 46)
18:06 Through the waters (Isaiah 43:1-2)
18:55 Renewed day by day (2 Corinthians 4:16-18)
19:42 Wait on the Lord (Psalm 27:13-14)
20:15 Nigh unto the broken hearted (Psalm 34)
20:57 He that keepeth thee (Psalm 121)
21:56 The peace of God (Philippians 4:6-7)
22:27 Perfect peace (Isaiah 26:3-4)
22:59 He calleth the stars by name (Psalm 147:3-5)
23:37 The lifter up of mine head (Psalm 3:3-5)
24:11 Under his wings (Psalm 91)
25:12 Blessing

Scripture in this prayer: Jeremiah 17:14; Psalm 147:3; Psalm 41:3; Isaiah 53:5; Psalm 46:10; Psalm 6:2; 2 Corinthians 4:16; Psalm 30:2; Psalm 103:2-3; Revelation 21:4; Romans 8:28; Psalm 3:5; Psalm 103:1-5, 8-13; Psalm 23; Psalm 46:1-3, 10-11; Isaiah 43:1-2; 2 Corinthians 4:16-18; Psalm 27:13-14; Psalm 34:4, 8, 18; Psalm 121; Philippians 4:6-7; Isaiah 26:3-4; Psalm 147:3-5; Psalm 3:3-5; Psalm 91:1-2, 4, 9-11; 3 John 1:2

Scripture quotations: King James Version (public domain).
